piece_hoe_smooth_desc: Smooths out bumps and dips in the ground without changing its overall height. Leaves dirt behind.
piece_hoe_flatten_desc: Flattens the ground to the height you are standing at, in a circle or a square. Leaves dirt behind.
piece_hoe_lower_desc: Digs the ground down a little with each use.
piece_hoe_raise_desc: Builds the ground up a little with each use, in a circle or a square. Leaves dirt behind.
piece_hoe_cultivate_smooth_desc: Smooths the ground and cultivates it, ready for planting.
piece_hoe_cultivate_flatten_desc: Flattens the ground to the height you are standing at and cultivates it, ready for planting.
piece_hoe_paved_smooth_desc: Smooths the ground and paves it with stone.
piece_hoe_paved_flatten_desc: Flattens the ground to the height you are standing at and paves it with stone.
piece_hoe_path_desc: Lays a round patch of dirt path without changing the ground's height.
piece_hoe_paint_dirt_desc: Paints dirt on the ground without changing its height.
piece_hoe_paint_cultivate_desc: Cultivates the ground, ready for planting, without changing its height.
piece_hoe_paint_paved_desc: Paves the ground with stone without changing its height.
piece_hoe_paint_grass_desc: Removes dirt, cultivation and paving so the ground goes back to its natural look and grass grows back. Does not change its height.
piece_hoe_ramp_desc: Click a start point, click an end point, then move sideways to set the width and click again. Carves a smooth ramp between the two heights.
piece_hoe_road_desc: Click points along the way, then click the last point again to build. The road curves smoothly through the points, and its height changes evenly from one point to the next.
piece_hoe_reset_terrain_desc: Resets the terrain inside the circle or square back to how the world made it. Uses the Tool Reset Radius and Reset Tool Shape from the config; a Tool Reset Radius of 0 uses the hoe's radius.
hoe_undo_too_far: Move closer to undo this change
hoe_plant_undo_too_far: Move closer to undo this plant
hoe_key_hd: Turn HD textures on or off
hoe_key_reset_hotkey: Reset the terrain around you ({0} m)
hoe_key_scale_x: Hold to change only the width
hoe_key_scale_y: Hold to change only the height
hoe_key_scale_z: Hold to change only the depth
hoe_key_road_build: Click the last point again to build the road
road_err_need_two: Pick a second point further away
road_err_size: Road is too big to build in one go
ramp_err_short: Too short. Pick a point further away.
ramp_err_size: Ramp is too big to build in one go
ramp_err_height: Too far from the original ground level ({0} m limit)
ramp_err_access: You can't change the terrain here
ramp_err_terrain: Aim at the ground to place a point
clutter_brush_desc: Paints clutter on the ground inside the brush circle. Change the radius like any other Paint piece. The density is set in the config.
clutter_eraser_desc: Erases painted clutter inside the brush circle. Change the radius like any other Paint piece.
piece_hoe_clear_forestry_desc: Removes trees, stumps, shrubs, rocks and pickables inside the brush circle. Nothing is dropped. Change the radius like any other Paint piece.
piece_hoe_rock_desc: A rock from the world. Rotate it like any other piece.
piece_mm_pond_01_desc: A rock-edged pond. Digs its own hollow and fills it with water. Removing it takes the water away and puts the ground back as it was.
piece_mm_pond_02_desc: A large, long rock-edged pond. Digs its own hollow and fills it with water. Removing it takes the water away and puts the ground back as it was.
piece_mm_pond_frog_desc: A croaking frog to sit on a pond's rocks.
mm_pond_blocked_tree: A tree is in the way
mm_pond_blocked_rock: A rock is in the way
mm_pond_protected: The ground under a pond can't be changed
